name: Sum of Remainders
description: Calculate the value of the sum: n mod 1 + n mod 2 + n mod 3 + ... + n mod m . As the result can be very large, you should print the value modulo 10 9 + 7 (the remainder when divided by 10 9 + 7 ). The modulo operator a mod b stands for the remainder after dividing a by b . For example 10 mod 3 = 1 .
input_specification: The only line contains two integers n , m ( 1 ≤ n , m ≤ 10 13 ) — the parameters of the sum.
output_specification: Print integer s — the value of the required sum modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Apply modular properties, binary exponentiation (a^b mod P in O(log b)), and modular multiplicative inverse using Extended Euclidean Algorithm.
